lead.event: OJK removes the three-platform borrowing limit for fintech borrowers
lead.headline: OJK removes three-platform limit, requires fintech lenders to keep TWP90 at 5% or less
lead.blurb: Borrowers may now use more than three P2P lenders under SEOJK 19/2025. Providers must improve financing analysis, apply prudence and good governance, and keep aggregate TWP90 at or below 5%; OJK executive Agusman called for stronger risk mitigation and financing-quality monitoring amid funding needs among MSMEs, short-term working capital borrowers and the informal sector. OJK also excludes debtors with outstanding credit below Rp1 million from SLIK records; August financing rose 22.07% year on year to Rp106.94 trillion, while TWP90 climbed to 4.73% from 4.32% in July.

market_structure_policy.headline: IDX implements intraday short selling in five stocks
market_structure_policy.blurb: The service launched on 1 October with Ajaib Sekuritas Asia and Semesta Indovest Sekuritas as the first licensed brokers. Positions must close on the same trading day, and investors must post at least Rp50 million or 50% of the transaction value, whichever is higher. Access is limited to domestic individual investors through 31 December 2026, before gradual expansion.

deals_control.event: Jhonlin Baratama acquires a 30.25% stake in Bayan Resources
deals_control.headline: Jhonlin Baratama acquires 30.25% of BYAN for Rp26.1 trillion
deals_control.blurb: Bayan Resources said the 10.08 billion shares were priced at Rp2,588 each, and the transaction was reported to the Indonesia Stock Exchange on 8 October. Low Tuck Kwong remains the controlling shareholder, and the company said its plans and operations are unchanged.

deals_control.event: Era Media Sejahtera prepares corporate actions to fund its planned INET acquisition
deals_control.headline: DOOH prepares four actions to fund planned 29.88% INET acquisition
deals_control.blurb: Proposals include a loan of up to Rp5 trillion from controlling shareholder Sinergi Internasional Investama and a rights issue of up to 154.77 billion shares, with dilution of up to 95.24%. CNI plans to buy 29.88% of INET for Rp2 trillion from Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara. Shareholders will discuss the proposals on 9 November.

deals_control.event: Prambanan Investasi Sukses completes its divestment of Era Media Sejahtera shares
deals_control.headline: Prambanan completes DOOH divestment as Beruntung Berkat holds 15.09%
deals_control.blurb: Prambanan Investasi Sukses sold 388.42 million Era Media Sejahtera shares to Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera on 12 October at Rp336 each. Beruntung Berkat holds 15.09%, while Prambanan’s stake is zero. A mandatory tender offer follows, priced using the 90-day average of highest daily trading prices before the takeover announcement.

deals_control.event: Astra International launches a voluntary tender offer for Astra Otoparts shares
deals_control.headline: ASII launches voluntary tender offer for up to 238.44 million AUTO shares
deals_control.blurb: Astra International plans to buy up to 238.44 million Astra Otoparts shares at Rp3,600 each, for up to Rp858.39 billion. The offer could raise its stake from 80% to 84.947%, and OJK declared the tender offer statement effective on 12 October.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: JARR and PGUN controlling shareholders pledge shares to Bank Mandiri
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: JARR and PGUN shareholders pledge Rp73 trillion in shares to BMRI
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Jhonlin Agro Raya’s controlling shareholder pledged 7.99 billion shares, or 86.64% of its outstanding shares, while three Pradiksi Gunatama shareholders pledged 5.30 billion on 30 September. Bank Mandiri holds them against affiliate credit facilities; by 12 October, JARR and PGUN had fallen 21.79% and 13.08%, respectively, from 30 September.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Maruwai Coal issues Rp2 trillion in bonds
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ADMR subsidiary Maruwai Coal issues Rp2 trillion in bonds
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Alamtri Minerals indirectly owns 99.99% of Maruwai Coal, whose bonds were recorded on 12 October. Series A is Rp1.22 trillion at 8% for 370 days. Series B is Rp780.24 billion at 8.75% for three years. 92% of proceeds is for capex, including a Central Kalimantan coal plant.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BTPN Syariah prepares a Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BTPS prepares Rp1 trillion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BTPN Syariah's planned buyback would equal 10% of its placed capital. Further details were not available.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Anabatic Technologies completes its rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ATIC completes rights issue, raises Rp280.37 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Anabatic Technologies issued 578.84 million new shares, with proceeds helping repay about Rp560 billion in convertible bonds. The repayment will also use a new Rp150 billion UOB facility and Rp129.62 billion of internal cash, with the interest-bearing debt-to-equity ratio projected to fall from 2.8 times at 30 June to 1.7 times.

earnings_guidance.event: Astra International reports nine-month 2026 car sales
earnings_guidance.headline: ASII reports 334,987 nine-month car sales, up 12.6%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra International sold 334,987 cars wholesale through September, taking 49% of the 679,018-unit national market. Separately, it is offering up to 238.44 million Astra Otoparts shares at Rp3,600 each, for a maximum Rp858.39 billion, with the offer running through 11 November.

earnings_guidance.event: SGER reports Rp4.33 trillion in revenue and Rp137.95 billion in net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: SGER reports Rp4.33 trillion in revenue and Rp137.95 billion in net profit

earnings_guidance.event: Waskita Karya reports nine-month 2026 financial results
earnings_guidance.headline: WSKT reports Rp2.87 trillion nine-month net loss
earnings_guidance.blurb: Waskita Karya's accumulated losses rose to Rp22.53 trillion from Rp20.22 trillion, and equity attributable to owners was negative Rp3.34 trillion at 30 September. The company said it was pursuing eight restructuring initiatives, had completed restructuring non-guaranteed bonds across four trustee agreements, and filed a Rp722 billion claim on 2021 Bond III on 25 September.
